title: Final report on Technical Advice on selected KPIs under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act
Summary: ESMA’s final report provides technical advice on selected Taxonomy disclosure KPIs, including revisions to the OpEx KPI, voluntary OpEx reporting by financial undertakings, group reporting and other possible simplifications.

title: Final Report on the update to the RTS concerning key financial information in the summary of a prospectus
Summary: ESMA proposes amendments to the RTS that reduce the historical financial information required in prospectus summaries to align with Listing Act changes, including removing the non-equity cash flow table.

title: Consultation on the update to the Guidelines on disclosure requirements under the Prospectus Regulation
Summary: ESMA consults on proposed updates to its Prospectus Regulation disclosure guidelines to reflect Listing Act amendments, including new guidance on management reports, profit forecasts, historical financial information and related-party transactions, and proposed consolidation of the risk-factor guidelines.

title: Final report on the guarantees as CCP collateral and CCP investment policy
Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out draft amendments to RTS 153/2013 specifying conditions for CCP acceptance of public, public bank and commercial bank guarantees as collateral, and targeted changes to CCP investment policy requirements for eligible debt instruments and secure deposit arrangements.

title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’
Summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential technical standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks arising when banking CSDs provide cash accounts to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes in EU legislation.

title: Consultation paper on draft RTS on Operational Risk management framework
Summary: The EBA consults on draft regulatory technical standards establishing a harmonised, proportionate framework for institutions’ operational risk governance, assessment, management, data, reporting, validation and oversight arrangements.

title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 7/2026
Summary: This instruction, in force from 27 August 2026, revokes Instruction No. 28/2018 and concerns prudential standards for credit institutions headquartered in Portugal.

title: Final report on Guidelines on the sound management of third-party risk related to non-ICT services
Summary: The final report sets out guidelines for financial entities to manage risks arising from third-party non-ICT services, with stricter requirements for arrangements supporting critical or important functions and supervisory attention to concentration risk.

title: Norma Regulamentar n.º 6/2026-R, de 20 de outubro - Reporte à ASF para supervisão da resiliência operacional digital
Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: The ASF regulation introduces digital operational resilience reporting requirements for ICT third-party arrangements, severe ICT incidents, significant cyber threats and ICT risk management, while revising cyber incident reporting and repealing overlapping requirements.

title: Consultation Paper on revised ITS on conditions of application of the joint decision process for institution-specific prudential requirements
Summary: The EBA consults on revised implementing technical standards to update and streamline the joint decision process for institution-specific prudential requirements, including Pillar 2 Guidance, leverage-ratio elements and qualitative supervisory measures.
